args.alt_text: City skyline at dusk with lit windows and a river in the foreground.

args.text:
Dear Nana,
The train was on time for once and the hotel looks right over the river. We watched the lights come on from the balcony last night.
Tomorrow: the market and the old lighthouse. Back on Sunday with stories (and fudge).
Love, Ben and Ada

Mrs. Eleanor Vance
9 Orchard Lane
Fairview, OR 97000
